description: Provision an AWS Eventbridge Archive via the ACK eventbridge controller. Fields mirror the eventbridge.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 Archive spec.

description.description:
A description for the archive.

Regex Pattern: `.*`

eventPattern.description: An event pattern to use to filter events sent to the archive.

eventSourceARN.description: The ARN of the event bus that sends events to the archive.

eventSourceRef.description:
AWSResourceReferenceWrapper provides a wrapper around *AWSResourceReference
type to provide more user friendly syntax for references using 'from' field
Ex:
APIIDRef:

	from:
	  name: my-api

from.description:
AWSResourceReference provides all the values necessary to reference another
k8s resource for finding the identifier(Id/ARN/Name)

name.description:
The name for the archive to create.

Regex Pattern: `^[\.\-_A-Za-z0-9]+$`

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

retentionDays.description:
The number of days to retain events for. Default value is 0. If set to 0,
events are retained indefinitely

title: AWS Eventbridge Archive
